title: Call Back the Greens
description: The Greens are specialists in poison, ambush, and unpleasant places that civilized people have the good sense to avoid. Gnarl's next recovery test is deliberately less dignified than the last: return with a spider eye. Once the Overlord has demonstrated suitable tolerance for vermin and venom, he can attempt to restore Green command.
description_completed: The Overlord has completed Gnarl's Green recovery test. Gnarl has attempted to restore the Green Minion capability through the Minion progression anchor.
